versions.content: Initialize PHYs with MACsec support, where MACsec func- tionality is enabled If EthTrcv_Init is called, then the EthTrcv driver shall initialize the Ethernet hard- ware (PHY) per EthTrcvConfig and consider the following configuration parameter if available, where EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is set to TRUE: • initialize the Ethernet hardware (PHY) with all configured EthTrcvMacSecBy- passEtherType s to bypass MACsec handling for all Ethernet frames, that car- rying one of the configured EtherTypes • initialize the Ethernet hardware (PHY) with all configured EthTrcvMacSecBy- passVlan s to bypass MACsec handling for all Ethernet frames, that carrying one of the configured VLAN-IDs • initialize the Ethernet hardware (PHY) with all configured EthTrcvMacSecBy- passDestinationMacAddress es to bypass MACsec handling for all Ethernet frames, that carrying one of the configured destination MAC addresses
